notes: Timeline = original WAV 'song/Context Window.wav' (identical to the gapless decode of song/context-window.mp3 up to the encoder delay handled by browsers); Demucs htdemucs_ft stems from the WAV, no offset. Tempo is constant: 150.007 BPM (period 0.39998 s), fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attack times; first beat 0.193 s. Bar phase 0 chosen by low-band (kick+bass) energy on beats; first downbeat 0.193 s. Sections: see data/sections.json (from lyric alignment, snapped to downbeats). Envelopes: 100 fps, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), normalised by 99th percentile, 0..1. low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength]: kick (249), snare/clap (90), hat (443) from the drums stem; vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem.
